moments.title: "It is very empowering" — and "I feel like I did it by myself"
moments.summary: The clearest line in the clip: a participant calls the programme very empowering, and the reason lands in the sentence just after — she feels like she did it by herself, rather than having been carried through it.
moments.evidence: So I think it's very empowering. That's why you feel like, oh, my god, you know. I know. I feel like I did it by myself.

moments.title: Before this she felt lost, with nowhere to ask questions
moments.summary: The admission that gives the empowerment line its weight: she says she feels lost and has no place to ask questions, and the alternative described just after is waiting for a man in the family to come round and explain basic things.
moments.evidence: I feel lost. And I don't have a place to ask questions.
